create_dynamic_separable_conv: create a DynamicSeparableConv2d module with configurable kernel size list and channels per group for NAS search
create_dynamic_point_conv: create a DynamicPointConv2d module that applies 1x1 convolution with dynamically selectable output channels
create_dynamic_linear: create a DynamicLinear layer with dynamically selectable output feature dimensions for neural architecture search
create_dynamic_batchnorm: create a DynamicBatchNorm2d module with shared BN weights across subnets and optional sync across distributed GPUs
create_dynamic_se: create a DynamicSE squeeze-and-excitation module that adapts to variable input channel dimensions at runtime
